g.text: 2026 El Niño: RO, RO + PMM and NASA GMAO

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #9b4335

g.text: All curves are three-month means, plotted at the central month; February–June issues / monthly-state initializations.
Skill uses the same 19 observed issue–season pairs across all six methods (center leads 1–5 months); longer curves are shown but not scored.
RO / observations: ERSSTv5 SSTA relative to 1991–2020, with the removed trend restored. IRI: published provider baselines, not harmonized.
RO uses completed monthly initial states; IRI is issued during the month. These are event comparisons, not equal-information real-time tests.
PMM: fixed-mode ERSSTv5 SST reconstruction. IRI: values read from official vector plumes (CC BY 4.0). NASA: GMAOv3 in May–Jun 2026.
